# Studenius

> Studenius is an AI-powered student learning platform built for academic excellence. It combines intelligent study tools, spaced repetition, and real-time AI tutoring to help students study smarter, retain more, and perform better on exams.

## What Studenius Does

Studenius gives students a full AI-powered study suite:

- **AI Tutor** — Real-time conversational AI tutor for any subject
- **Cram Mode / Quick Study** — AI-generated high-yield study sheets for fast exam prep
- **Flashcards** — Smart flashcard creator with AI-assisted generation
- **Feynman Mode (TeachIt)** — Learn by teaching; AI evaluates your explanation
- **Math Solver** — Step-by-step AI math problem solver
- **High Yield Detector** — Identifies the most testable concepts from any topic
- **Recall Mode** — Active recall quizzing powered by AI
- **Mistake Journal** — Tracks your weak areas and resurfaces them for review
- **Focus Timer** — Deep work sessions with productivity tracking
- **Study DNA / Analytics** — Visualizes your learning patterns and subject mastery
- **Source Library** — Upload PDFs and lecture notes; AI tools use them as context
- **Arena** — Competitive quiz battles against other students
- **Study Planner** — AI-assisted weekly study scheduling

## Who It's For

Students in high school, college, and university — especially those preparing for exams, board reviews, or competitive academics. Built with a focus on medical, science, and engineering students but supports all subjects.

## Technology

- Built with React, TypeScript, Vite
- AI powered by Groq (llama3) via Cloudflare Worker proxy
- Backend: Supabase (auth + database)
- Deployed on Cloudflare Pages
- Available at https://studenius.com

## Pricing

- **Free Plan** — Limited daily AI credits, core tools accessible
- **Studenius VIP (Pro)** — ₱199/month or ₱1,499/year; unlimited AI, all tools, priority generation
